name: demangle_swift
description: Demangle an ordered list of single-line Swift symbols without requiring Hopper. Each input returns demangled, unchanged, or invalid status. An exact underscore input skipped by swift-demangle is invalid with empty output; it does not discard valid companion results. native_command_timeout_ms is the swift-demangle wall clock (omitted means 60000 ms) and does not raise the fixed 67108864-byte output allowance.

parameters.description: Advertised in reduced form by the compact input schema profile; the server still validates complete canonical inputs.

native_command_timeout_ms.description: Wall-clock budget in milliseconds for each macOS native command in this call (lipo, codesign, plutil, swift-demangle, and the other allowlisted Xcode tools). Omitted means 60000. Integer from 1 to 2147483647. Applies on the next call. Does not raise the fixed 67108864-byte output allowance or the 65536-byte failure-diagnostic excerpt. Named native_command_timeout_ms rather than command_timeout_ms because command_timeout_ms is the separate one-shot objdump and rizin deadline (default 120000).
